description: This file defines a test utility class 'OrderBuilder' used for constructing 'Order' objects with different sets of default or specified values for unit testing in the eShopOnWeb application.

classes.name: OrderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate creating 'Order' objects with preset or custom values for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: OrderBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing an OrderBuilder instance, setting up default catalog item and initial order.

methods.name: WithDefaultValues
methods.description: Creates an 'Order' with default test data including one order item.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Creates an 'Order' with a specified list of items.
